description: Lists pump.fun token launches from the last N minutes (decoded from Solana mainnet within about a minute), each with its creator wallet, that wallet's seven-day launch count, and, when the coin's name matches a topic currently trending on Google Trends or moving on Polymarket, the matched trend with its source and score. Launch data only; it does not rate, recommend or trade anything. Price: $0.005 per call in USDC (x402).

creator.description: Only launches by this creator wallet (base58).

trendOnly.description: Only launches matched to a live off-chain trend.

name: recent_launches
title: Recent pump.fun launches, trend-matched
